reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Reconstructed the Dutch Human Resource Studies pathway from the freshly retrieved adopted Appendix I, separately reread its learning outcomes, choice rule and general thesis gate, then challenged each positive alignment and the finished UCR curricula against actual course evidence. This is a separate analytical pass by the same AI, not an independent person.
findings: The exact Dutch target is not English People Management. The adopted 2026–2027 table verifies thirteen first-year units totalling sixty EC, ten six-credit second-year units, thirty open EC, one six-credit professionalisation choice, two six-credit taught third-year units and a twelve-credit thesis. Coaching and Development follows the neutral first-listed tie-break. Non-credit GROW is separate.

The current general OER supplies a 120 EC bachelor thesis threshold; both first years meet it. The open window permits combinations rather than three mutually exclusive full-window alternatives only. It remains uninstantiated. The primary programme page supplies substance and identifies health, performance, strategic HRM, consulting and organisational context; its older cohort label is not silently relabelled as current evidence.

The strongest UCR response has sustained organisational psychology, leadership and multiple research methods, accounting, economics and digital strategy. Psychology and development and institutions and policy are coherent candidate priorities corroborated by the thirteen direct interests. Clinical and neurobiological study supports psychological-health foundations without being employee-selection training. The institutional option studies legal and political environments, microeconomic labour markets and organisations without claiming employment-law coverage.

Rechecked all eleven positive alignments from underlying subject or methodological overlap. Removed the old rhetoric-versus-academic-writing, constitutional-versus-labour-law, clinical-versus-employee-assessment, ethics-versus-philosophy-of-science and meta-analysis-versus-coaching matches. Preserved specialist blanks and optional research outside scheduled credits. All three complete curricula meet the current workbook hard constraints and pairwise floor.

Read thirty-nine selected course names and descriptions, twenty-eight external labels, five note anchors, three concepts, programme and route labels, two limitation notes, source links and optional-research placement. The audience and normal presentation references select the intended content without exposing internal source history.
